question.text: Which of the following statements is correct for a spontaneous polymerization reaction ?

solution.text:
Hint : $n A \rightarrow A_n$
During spontaneous polymerisation reaction number of particles decreases, hence entropy decreases. Being spontaneous $\Delta \mathrm{G}$ of the reaction is less than zero.
$\Delta \mathrm{G}=\Delta \mathrm{H}-\mathrm{T} \Delta \mathrm{S}$
To make the $\Delta \mathrm{G}$ negative, $\Delta \mathrm{H}$ must be negative i.e. less than zero.
